## About
We're Bob's Heating & Air on Oak St in Roswell. We get heat back up and running, replace full HVAC systems and put in mini-splits for homes around here.
One customer put it this way: working with us "feels as though you have known them for years." Bob, our partner Shawn Sheffield and Josh McKnight take the time to show you what's wrong and walk you through the work.
We're rated 4.9 on Google from 66 reviews, and we'd like to earn yours too.

## Services
- Heat back up and running: When the heat goes out, we find what's wrong and get it going. One customer said Josh had their heat back within 30 minutes.
- HVAC system replacement: We'll come out, look at your home and quote a replacement system, with the pricing explained plainly.
- Mini-split: A mini-split for cooling a single room, like a bedroom, without running the whole floor.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: Our listed hours are weekdays only. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work with both ducted and cassette mini-splits?
A: Yes. We've put in ducted mini-splits and ceiling cassette systems, and we'll talk through which fits your room.

## What customers say
- "We've been using Bob' Heating and Air exclusively for the past 5 years for a variety of HVAC needs.  Recently, we wanted a mini-split installed in our master bedroom in order to cool that room down to 66 degrees in the evening without having to cool the entire main floor to the same temperature.  In addition, we have a dehumidifier installed in our lower level HVAC unit that didn't appear to be working at all.  So we contacted Bob's and met with them to discuss options for the mini-split.  While we had heard good things about the ceiling mounted mini-splits (cassettes), Bob's suggested a ducted mini-split as a less intrusive option.  Since our expectations were that the two different systems operated the same, we went with the ducted version.

The first install didn't go as planned, as the compressor unit was damaged during shipment, which appeared cosmetic only.  After this first install, the system didn't seem to function as expected, as it took over 4 hours to cool down the room.  After following up with Bob's, they came in the following week and replaced the entire system, after they tested the original unit and found that it was not operating per specs.  They also checked out the dehumidifier and found that it was basically dead (running, but not dehumidifying).  So that was replaced as Bob's realized it still had a year left on the warranty.

After using the system for a week, we realized that the ducted system was good at maintaining a specific temperature, but couldn't cool the room down in a reasonable time span.  Again, we contacted Bob's and they offered to replace the ducted system with the cassette system.  So, after waiting for the shipment of the cassette system, Bob's came back out and installed an entirely new system, which now meets our expectations.

While the whole process was quite a journey, we couldn't be happier with the customer service provided by Bob's.  They went above and beyond to ensure that we were satisfied with the new unit and dehumidifier replacement.  I don't know many contractors (HVAC or otherwise) that would have gone through this whole process like Bob's did (we are happy, and they are happy that we are happy).  We will continue to use Bob's exclusively for all our HVAC services." (Mike Dorman, 5/5)
